key_insight: Published quantum research often lacks the operational details AI scientists need, but verified workflow repairs can become reusable experience that improves reproduction.
engineering_relevance: Reusable, verified workflows could make automated quantum research more reliable and cost-efficient without upgrading the underlying language model.
method: Build OmniQ, an expert-audited environment translating 59 papers into executable reproduction tasks.
Use Residual Agents to distil externally verified workflow repairs into reusable research experience.
Expose reproduced results and verified workflows through an extensible Model Context Protocol platform.
evidence_signal: Evaluation spans five LLM-powered agentic systems and six third-party harnesses; Residual Agents raises reported DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance from 68% to 85%, matching Claude Code with Opus 5 at one-third the cost.
watch_item: The approach depends on external verification, and generalization beyond the 59-paper evaluation remains to be established.
paper_title: Reimagining computational quantum research with AI scientists
